body:
"The single largest change in this version is the adoption of NIST 800-63, concentrating on introducing controls at authentication assurance levels 1 through 3" -> Adding a small sentence on NIST 800-63 would be useful as the reader may not be familiar with the standard.

"We have re-validated L1 to be a "Core" or "Essential" control set, by setting a CVSS score bar of 7.5 or above to be in L1" -> not all controls are mappable to CVSS such as logging requirements, etc.  Also, common vulnerabilities such as XSS are typically below this.  I would suggest removing this.

comments.body: Agree with suggestions and implemented them. Thanks
